title: Breaking the Joint Action Space Dependence in Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the sample complexity of learning robust coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in finite-horizon, general-sum, distributionally robust Markov games with known rewards and a generative model of the nominal transitions. Each player evaluates a policy by its worst-case return over total-variation (TV) balls centered at the nominal transition distribution of every stage, state, and joint action; this is the standard $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set. Existing generative-model guarantees for this model scale with the number $\prod_iA_i$ of joint actions, where $A_i$ is the number of actions of player~$i$. Since this number grows exponentially with the number of players, these guarantees suffer from the curse of multiagency. We design an algorithm whose sample complexity depends on the action sets only through the largest individual action-set size $A_*:=\max_iA_i$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ transition

translated_title: 打破分布鲁棒多智能体强化学习中对联合动作空间的依赖
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在有限时域、一般和、分布鲁棒马尔可夫博弈中学习鲁棒粗相关均衡（CCE）的样本复杂度，其中奖励已知，且拥有名义转移的生成模型。每个玩家通过其在以每个阶段、状态和联合动作的名义转移分布为中心的总变差（TV）球上的最坏情况回报来评估策略；这是标准的 $(s,a)$ 矩形不确定性集。针对该模型，现有基于生成模型的样本保证随联合动作数量 $\prod_i A_i$（其中 $A_i$ 是玩家 $i$ 的动作数量）而扩展。由于该数量随玩家数量呈指数增长，这些保证饱受“多智能体维数灾难”之苦。我们设计了一种算法，其样本复杂度仅通过最大个体动作集大小 $A_* := \max_i A_i$ 依赖于动作集。该算法使用 $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ 次转移采样
tldr: 该论文设计了一种分布鲁棒多智能体强化学习算法，其样本复杂度仅依赖于最大个体动作集大小而非随玩家数指数增长的联合动作数，从而打破了多智能体维数灾难。
en_tdlr: This paper designs an algorithm for distributionally robust multi-agent reinforcement learning whose sample complexity depends on the action sets only through the largest individual action-set size, thereby breaking the exponential curse of multiagency in the joint action space.
